choice.why_divider: Lowering the OVP from the 20 V-input setting (22.76-25.60 V) to the 15 V input is the cleaner fix: it is a one-resistor change on the protection that is supposed to act first, it also coordinates D1 (SMBJ22A, VBR 24.4 V) for the first time, and it keeps the TVS clamp low. pulse_budget.basis: 1 A x VC 32.4 V (rated clamp bounds the 1 A clamp: 24.92 V at 25 C, 27.71 V at Tj 150 C via alphaVBR) x 20 ms = 0.648 J. Capability: 600 W 10/1000 us rating mapped to a 20 ms rectangle with a sqrt(t) thermal impedance (Dawson peak 0.541044) = 87.2 W at 25 C, x0.8 Fig. 2 derating at 50 C = 69.8 W. No universal joule rating or continuous claim; 5 W steady-state rating applies only on an infinite heat sink.

S92_enable_logic_from_netlist.method: Structure traced from the design connectivity (LMR38020 EN pin -> divider -> PNP collector -> base pull-ups and series NMOS sink chain -> GND); bounds over VPD 12.26/16.5/19.44 V, resistor tolerance + TCR, NMOS VGS(th) 1.0-2.5 V with 1 uA leakage, PNP hFE >= 60, VEB <= 0.35 V off and 5 uA leakage. With a switch open the switches above it are source followers (node <= gate), so the chain current is bounded by the node defaults; a chain node with no DC default is undefined.

S92_startup_qualification.strict_3A_outcome: FAULT latched at ARMED after repeated U5 UVLO dropouts (fail-safe, RUN low, input off); NOT a single-attempt start
S92_startup_qualification.meaning: A strictly 3.00 A-limited 15 V source cannot supply the simultaneous soft-start charge of both rails at the published load and rack; the module then fails safe and needs RESET. Real PD sources with overload headroom (peak-current capability, OCP above ~4.7 A for a few ms) are expected to start it: post-prototype acceptance test S1 decides, per source.

startup_arming.topology: STARTED = U12 A (PRE_N = START_N = NAND(MAIN_LED_OK, RUN), CLR_N = RESET_N, CLK low); TIMER_GO = RUN AND STARTED; ARMED = U11 output

requirements.R1: bounded arming: converters enabled and unarmed only within the U11 delay after the first enable since RESET
requirements.R2: no restart: ARMED rises once per RESET, t_d after the first enable, whatever MAIN_OK/VPD/rails do
requirements.R3: no early arming: never before a genuine converter enable (U5 on with valid status); the PD 5 V phase cannot start it
requirements.R4: fail-safe: after ARMED any bad status > ~1 ms latches FAULT; FAULT keeps RUN low until RESET; OV_N presets FAULT at any time

required: R1 bounded: ARMED within the U11 delay (0.31-0.88 s) of the first converter enable after RESET, and held until RESET/FAULT: the converters can never run unarmed for longer
R2 no restart: nothing a fault can toggle (MAIN_OK, PGOOD, VPD, V20_OK, the rails) restarts or extends the window; only RESET (or a power-on reset) does

R3 no early arming: the window starts only at a genuine converter enable, i.e. U5 on through its own UVLO with valid status; the PD 5 V phase or an intermediate PDO cannot start it, so no threshold below the converter enable point can arm
R4 fail-safe: after ARMED any bad status > ~1 ms latches FAULT; FAULT holds RUN low until RESET; OV_N (U20 guard: +12V and -12V channels) presets FAULT at any time

topology.STARTED: U12 flip-flop A used as a set/reset latch: PRE_N = START_N, CLR_N = RESET_N, CLK = GND (no clock edges), D = V3V3, Q = STARTED (TP19)
topology.START_N: U14 gate 2: NAND(MAIN_LED_OK, RUN, V3V3, V3V3); low once U5 is on with PGOOD and FLT good, its status validated by V20_OK, while RUN. Level-sensitive, so a MAIN_OK that is already high at RESET release (PGOOD deglitch) still starts it; RUN in the gate keeps PRE_N high while RESET clears the latch
topology.TIMER_GO: U13 gate 3 = RUN AND STARTED -> R69/R70 -> U11 SENSE (unchanged divider)
topology.ARMED: U11 RESET output (R71 pull-up) = ARMED directly; it stays high because its input is latched
topology.ANY_BAD: U14 gate 1 = NAND(MAIN_LED_OK, P12_OK, N12_OK, V3V3): S9.0 ties the former P5_OK input high
topology.FAULT: U12 flip-flop B: CLK = ARMED AND BAD_FILTERED (U13 gate 2, R72/C51 + U15), PRE_N = OV_N, CLR_N = RESET_N; RUN = RESET_N AND NOT_FAULT (U5 SHDN; U2 EN = MAIN_OK; U4 via Q1)
topology.parts: no new IC: the spare U14 gate and U12 flip-flop A re-used; S9.0 R83 120k -> 100k (Basic, the 100k line of R2/R6/R14/R16/R17, no new code), TP19 (copper)

V20_OK.role: U5 status-validity floor: masks U5 FLT/PGOOD (MAIN_OK, R63 pull-up) where U5 is below its 4.5 V operating minimum (PD 5 V phase); NOT an input-good threshold
V20_OK.rule: band minimum >= vSafe5V max 5.5 V + 2.0 V and band maximum <= U5 turn-off minimum - 2.0 V
V20_OK.consequence: whenever U5 can be on (VPD >= its 11.37 V turn-off minimum) V20_OK is high, so MAIN_LED_OK = MAIN_OK there and V20_OK can never be the first status to drop; ANY_BAD = NOT(MAIN_LED_OK AND P12_OK AND N12_OK) means "U5 not on with valid status, or a rail below its monitor threshold"
V20_OK.history: S8.5 (20 V input): R83 120k, 9.06-10.96 V. At the 15 V input its maximum sits above the U5 turn-off minimum less 2 V, so S9.0 uses 100k. S8.4 200k / S8.3 220k tripped inside the U5 band (they meant neither "input good" nor "status valid")

enable_logic.equation: EN_N - V(-12V) = Q1 on ? (VPD - VCEsat - V(-12V))*R18/(R17+R18) : Ileak*R18
enable_logic.off_pullup: R112 ties Q1 base to VPD; R115 100k defines N_EN_RETURN; R18 pulls EN to the U4 ground
enable_logic.method: Structure traced from the design connectivity (LMR38020 EN pin -> divider -> PNP collector -> base pull-ups and series NMOS sink chain -> GND); bounds over VPD 12.26/16.5/19.44 V, resistor tolerance + TCR, NMOS VGS(th) 1.0-2.5 V with 1 uA leakage, PNP hFE >= 60, VEB <= 0.35 V off and 5 uA leakage. With a switch open the switches above it are source followers (node <= gate), so the chain current is bounded by the node defaults; a chain node with no DC default is undefined.
enable_logic.supply_loss_response: MAIN_OK has falling deglitch; until it drops a powered converter can sink a bus. Clamp test bounds that finite interval; never parallel a running module.

pulse_budget.basis: 1 A x VC 32.4 V (rated clamp bounds the 1 A clamp: 24.92 V at 25 C, 27.71 V at Tj 150 C via alphaVBR) x 20 ms = 0.648 J. Capability: 600 W 10/1000 us rating mapped to a 20 ms rectangle with a sqrt(t) thermal impedance (Dawson peak 0.541044) = 87.2 W at 25 C, x0.8 Fig. 2 derating at 50 C = 69.8 W. No universal joule rating or continuous claim; 5 W steady-state rating applies only on an infinite heat sink.

D24.protects: U2 VIN/SW1 42V abs /36V operating; 50V VIN bank and C25/C26 (32.4+14.02=46.4V); U5 OUT 67V; D25 30V at the 1 A budget (<=27.7V hot)
D24.coordination: U5 OVP 17.30-19.44 V opens the input before D24 conducts: OVP max < VR 20 V < VBR(0 C) 21.70 V
D24.limitations: Rated clamp is at 25C and specified waveform, not a measured PCB spike bound. Qualified fixture requires VIN<=30V incl ringing at 25/50C. Sustained enabled reverse power is NOT safe.

D25.scope: Bus slew <=1 V/s at 25C (<=26.5uA displacement current from 2x10u+100n rated high C). Not a cold/fast-hotplug clamp.

D26.protects: U2 VOUT/SW2/ISP/ISN 25V abs and local 25V MLCCs; not a 16V downstream guarantee
D26.limitations: Finite pulse backstop only; external rail source must be removed by fixture. No fuse coordination / crowbar or sustained shunt claim.

conditions: T1-A: no USB input, +/-12.0 and +/-12.6V external bus, 1A source limit, 0.44mF each rail; ramp <=1V/s at 25C, hold 10s; log EN_N relative to -12V, U4 SW, VIN and bus currents
T1-B: same with USB present and FAULT latched/RUN low; verify off-state once MAIN_OK deglitch expires and capture the preceding <=20ms interval
T1-C: only negative rail applied with same bounded slew; repeat rail order

T1-D: inject a positive 1A, <=20ms pulse into VIN at TP26 (compliance 33V, automatic disconnect), 25/50C, >=200s between pulses. This separately tests D24 energy/clamp; never assume the now-disabled U4 will generate this pulse
pass_criteria: T1-A/C: EN_N minus -12V <=0.11V settled (<=0.5V transient), zero U4 switching; VIN -0.3..1V after 100ms settled; each bus current <10mA after 100ms
T1-B: same EN/switching/current criteria after 20ms; VIN may retain own-input charge, must remain -0.3..30V, not climb from bus power
T1-D: VIN <=30V incl ringing at TP26, measured integral(V*I*dt)<=0.648J, clamp current ends by 20ms, no leakage increase >10uA after cooling; normal restart and regulation after RESET
All: automatic overvoltage disconnect at VIN 33V, negative excursion abort at -0.3V (fast comparator, not human reaction). An abort is a FAIL, not a pass.
bench_test.excluded: Hard hotplug, temperatures below25C for D25 forward-drop guarantee, >1A or >20ms sustained injection, and powered parallel supplies require new protection/qualification.

rail_overvoltage.decision: ACCEPTED architecture: no voltage-triggered fuse/crowbar; crowbar vs eFuse deferred/open. S9.1 D26 is a finite-energy transient backstop, not continuous shunt protection.
rail_overvoltage.response: U20 presets FAULT and opens U5; it does NOT disconnect an external rail source or immediately discharge stored energy.
why_no_fuse: A fuse responds to current, not voltage.
D24/D26 TVS pulse ratings do not authorize sustained reverse power.
rail_overvoltage.limitations: Energy screens are NOT guaranteed peaks. Internal U2 OVP 24.5V is never used as an ideal clamp. No-load output can exceed16V; -12V has no positive-magnitude clamp. Unrelated failed-short components and unlimited external supplies are excluded.

conditions: T2-A: input16.5V; 0.44mF +0.5A/rail; externally ramp +12V from12 to16.5V at<=1V/ms, <=1A, total injection<=10ms (including ramp), hold<=1ms at16.5V; fixture removes injection automatically after trigger; scope>=100MS/s
T2-B: R8 open at13.5/16.5V input, 3A source; no external C/no load, then0.44mF+0.5A; capture500ms with independent voltage/current abort
T2-C: R14 open, same conditions; no assumed LMR38020 output OVP
T2-D: RUN held low/logic powered, +14.0V and -13.0V external for10min; safely BELOW the minimum guard thresholds; no-trip only refers to OV_N, not RUN
T2-E: at+15.2V / -13.9V a trip is ALLOWED (inside tolerance bands); repeat guaranteed trip at+15.8V / -14.5V with <=1V/ms slew, <=1A source and >=50us hold (record actual waveform)
pass_criteria_this_module: With >=0.5V rail overdrive beyond each measured trip, OV_N low/FAULT set/RUN low <=20us; MAIN LED off. Keep FAULT latched10s after injection removed, reset explicitly only after fault repair

Externally driven rail remains externally driven until fixture removal: NEVER require it off while injection remains. After removal connect1k/1W discharge load; both rails below1V within2s at <=0.44mF external C

T2-B/C: observed positive rail peak<=24.0V and negative magnitude<=24.0V for the500ms capture; positive duration above16V<=100ms with specified1k discharge; D26 pulse energy<=0.10J; normal regulation after repair/RESET

T2-D OV_N stays high. T2-E band points may trip or not; above-band points MUST trip. Automatic abort at+24V / -24V / VIN33V, source removed in<=2us; any abort fails qualification, no human-only protection
downstream_qualification: Without a separate rail protector, downstream modules must tolerate16.5V/10s and sub-threshold +15.3V/-14.1V continuously, and up to24V magnitude/100ms or their measured actual exposure if worse. Ordinary16V caps are NOT thereby qualified; incompatible modules excluded until crowbar/eFuse decision.

sourcing.selected_part_evidence: s92-sourcing.json (live, every S9.2 code incl. alternates); sourcing.json full live audit
sourcing.basic_only_policy: S9.2 Basic/Extended policy: every resistor and capacitor is a Basic part except the documented electrical exceptions R2/R3 (0.1 % UVLO), R93/R94/R98/R99 (0.1 % guard dividers) and R109 (18 mOhm 1 W metal-alloy shunt, no Basic part exists). ICs, transistors, TVS/Schottky diodes, the inductors and connectors are Extended where JLCPCB has no Basic equivalent. Every machine-assembled part has a C-code with live stock at the dated audit; alternates are recorded in the Alternates field. J2/J3 (box headers) and D8 (panel LED) stay owner-fitted manual parts by the S7/S8 module policy; JLCPCB THT codes are noted for them.

LS-1 loop gain with the real rack (PM > 45 deg, GM > 10 dB), CL-1/T1 clamp energy, T2 rail overvoltage
